definitions.explanation: Small pellets of ice that fall from the sky, smaller than hailstones (雹).

examples.japanese: {霰|あられ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

examples.english: I can hear hail hitting the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本海側|にほんかいがわ}→日本海側：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霰|あられ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There's a lot of graupel on the Japan Sea side in winter.

notes:
{霰|あられ} refers to small ice pellets that fall from clouds, technically called graupel. Distinct from ⟦{雹|ひょう}→雹：17632_hyou⟧ (hailstones), which are larger.

SIZE DISTINCTION:
- {霰|あられ}: ice pellets under 5mm in diameter
- ⟦{雹|ひょう}→雹：17632_hyou⟧: hailstones 5mm or larger

RELATED WEATHER TERMS:
- ⟦{雹|ひょう}→雹：17632_hyou⟧: hail (larger, more damaging)
- ⟦{霙|みぞれ}→霙：06505_mizore⟧: sleet (rain and snow mix)
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧: snow
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {霰|あられ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: hail falls
- {霰|あられ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧: hail starts falling

OTHER MEANING:
あられ also refers to small cube-shaped rice crackers ({霰|あられ}⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧), named for their resemblance to hail pellets. Common in ⟦{日本海|にほんかい}→日本海：30773_nihonkai⟧⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (Sea of Japan side) during winter.
